summary: Move guarantee uploads into their guarantee rows, remove the marked note, and change the agreement form action to save then submit the saved revision for independent approval.

lead_decisions.decision: Publish means SUBMIT for independent review, not APPROVE or immediate activation.
lead_decisions.basis: The user previously chose one independent approver with agreement or credit permission; the creator cannot approve their own request. The existing backend transitions a submitted revision to PENDING and activates only after a separate APPROVE action.

lead_decisions.decision: Only the full agreement editor (view=agreements) uses Save and Publish. Credit/guarantee sub-section editors keep their existing save-only behavior.
lead_decisions.basis: The screenshot shows the complete agreement editor; a focused credit or guarantee edit must not unexpectedly submit an agreement.

lead_decisions.decision: Protected documents may require a second action-local code/confirmation step after the draft is saved.
lead_decisions.basis: The user's prior Option 1 requires a fresh confidential-code grant per submit/approval actor; the uploader's grant cannot be reused as submission authority.

lead_decisions.decision: The existing default submission reason is retained.
lead_decisions.basis: The submit workflow already records this descriptive reason and the service requires at least three characters.

advisor_evidence.recommendation: Capture the saved agreement result, then submit its exact ID/version with a distinct stable requestId; keep save and submit retry paths separate, renew confidential grants without changing semantic request identity, and stop the chain if the original context changes.

invariants: Save and submit are separate phases. Capture saveAgreementTerms().data and submit that exact saved agreement ID/version using a distinct requestId.
After save succeeds, retry submission only; never resave or create another revision when a submit outcome is uncertain.
Freeze the submit request's ID, version, reason and semantic payload while its outcome is uncertain. Renew transient grants without changing request identity.

Submission starts in a fresh actor/session/organization/authorized-branch/proof scope. Never reuse upload or save grants; mint fresh CONFIDENTIAL_VIEW grants for each distinct protected proof on submit.

Verify actor, session, organization, branch and editor/action generation after each dependent async boundary and before the next command. A stale operation must not submit or update a newly selected context.

A saved draft whose submit fails remains a draft; report the partial result and resume the same submit. Pending scans may be saved but cannot submit until CLEAN; changed pinned versions remain rejected and must not be silently repinned.
Duplicate clicks and uploads in progress cannot create duplicate save or submit commands. Keep the existing exact-slot upload protections.
Only SUBMIT is called from Save and Publish. No API, backend approval, permission, Documents policy, API contract, schema, migration, dependency or operational data change is authorized.

Guarantee rows use the existing canonical inline uploader directly where the attachment selector currently appears. Retain attached-document removal, upload status/errors, exact branch/org binding, and access checks; remove the redundant selector and nested upload disclosure for guarantee rows.
Remove only the screenshot-marked draft/approval guidance note. Preserve validation feedback, upload errors, required workflow reason and dialog accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: The agreement editor's primary action reads 'ذخیره و انتشار'; sub-section-only editors keep their current save behavior.
A successful save captures the saved record and transitions that exact revision through the existing SUBMIT route to PENDING independent review.
A protected proof requires fresh code/grant for submission; no proof token or code is persisted, logged, echoed, or reused from upload/save.
A failed/uncertain submit never claims publication. The draft remains recoverable and retry does not resave.
Independent approval remains required for activation and the creator remains ineligible to review their own submission.
Every guarantee presents the upload field inline, with the separate no-attachment selector and nested disclosure absent.
The marked helper note is absent.
adversarial_checks: New agreement and amendment: save once and submit returned ID/version with a different requestId; final state is PENDING and prior active revision remains unchanged.
Save committed but response was lost: retry identical save request, then submit exactly once.
Submit committed but response was lost: retry only the identical submit command; do not replay the superseded save.
Expired grant: preserve the submit requestId and payload while renewing grants without duplicate revision/transition.
Contract plus multiple guarantees and duplicate document IDs: obtain fresh grants for every distinct protected proof and never reuse upload/save grants.
Pending scan: draft saves, submit is rejected, then the same submit succeeds after CLEAN; a changed pinned version stays rejected.
Actor/session/organization/branch/editor changes during save or grant issuance: do not submit or apply completion to the new context.
Rapid double-click and upload-in-progress: at most one logical save and submit; uncertain commands cannot be edited.
Wrong user/session/document/purpose, unavailable metadata or missing access: fail closed; secret codes/tokens remain out of persistence, storage, errors and fingerprints.
Creator with approval permission still cannot approve; a different approver needs their own current grants.
Inline guarantee upload retains attachment removal, exact-slot completion, scan/error feedback and permission gating.
